Name: (FS) Nyapu Farmer Portraits Outfits
Author: TrappedEgo
Description:
[b][i]Welcome to my first ever mod! 
[/i][/b]
ever wanted to be as accurate as you can to your portrait and character? well you can now!.. ish i say that cuz i couldn't really do every single hat and clothes. this is my first time i ever made a mod like.. ever, i did this as a kind of passion project and though it doesn't look like much i really did the best i could! i tried learning as best i could with the coding and drawing.

i am taking criticism, i would love to make updates and make these clothing's and hats look good, i couldn't understand somethings so not everything came out as i wanted..

this mod is referencing the lovely other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29697?ta]Nyapu's Farmers Portraits![/url] check it out it is a lovely mod!!


[b][i][u]FIRST![/u]
[/i][/b]i have had to make some clothing's sleeveless.. being i didn't know how to make the sleeves not change color, until i learn how to update it i recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15431]This Pack[/url] I'm sorry but I'm really really new to this. going down further is a list of the hats i added and alternatives to the ones i haven't added. once i get better and learn more i am willing to update this mod to eventually add all hats and clothing, but right now, my brain is smooth, very smooth.
